description: This file contains a test suite for the litellm router, specifically testing the initialization and configuration of clients, timeouts, environment-based model selection, and compatibility with various providers like Azure, OpenAI, Xinference, etc. It uses pytest for testing and includes multiple test functions covering different scenarios related to router setup and behavior.

methods.name: test_init_clients
methods.description: Tests the initialization of four different clients within the router, verifying cache entries and timeout configurations after router creation.

methods.name: test_init_clients_basic
methods.description: Performs a basic test of client initialization for a single model, verifying cache creation and correctness of configuration.

methods.name: test_init_clients_basic_azure_cloudflare
methods.description: Tests initialization of various models with Azure Cloudflare and OpenAI providers, ensuring that clients are properly set up.

methods.name: test_timeouts_router
methods.description: Verifies that the router raises a timeout error when configured with very low timeouts during a completion request.

methods.name: test_stream_timeouts_router
methods.description: Checks if the router correctly selects the client with the appropriate stream timeout for streaming responses.

methods.name: test_xinference_embedding
methods.description: Tests the initialization and compatibility of Xinference model within the router, ensuring correct API base configuration.

methods.name: test_router_init_gpt_4_vision_enhancements
methods.description: Tests the initialization of a GPT-4 vision model with specific Azure extensions and data sources, verifying configuration details.

methods.name: test_openai_with_organization
methods.description: Tests the handling of OpenAI models with organizational settings, both in sync and async modes, verifying correct organization headers.

methods.name: test_init_clients_azure_command_r_plus
methods.description: Ensures the router uses OpenAI clients for Azure Command R+ models, verifying client type via string inspection.

methods.name: test_aaaaatext_completion_with_organization
methods.description: Checks completion requests with organizational context, ensuring errors are raised for invalid orgs and successful responses for valid ones.

methods.name: test_init_clients_async_mode
methods.description: Verifies that only async clients are initialized when the router is set to asynchronous-only mode.

methods.name: test_init_router_with_supported_environments
methods.description: Tests environment-based model selection, ensuring only models supported by the current environment are active.
